question: Does the live-proof waiver recorded for the earlier microphone-readiness fix also cover this PR’s new paired-node delayed-recovery path, or should this PR retain the real-behavior-proof gate until a Meet-capable node is available?
rationale: The earlier merged waiver covered deterministic readiness branches, while this PR adds a different recovery path involving node affinity, tab reuse, and delayed audio startup; only a maintainer can decide whether the prior waiver applies.

options.title: Keep the proof gate
options.body: Require redacted paired-node runtime logs or a recording after the node is available, showing blocked stale/unknown health and successful single-tab recovery.

options.title: Extend the prior waiver
options.body: Explicitly waive live proof for this recovery path if the focused regression suite is accepted as sufficient for the unavailable private Meet environment.

recommendation.title: Keep the proof gate
recommendation.body: Require redacted paired-node runtime logs or a recording after the node is available, showing blocked stale/unknown health and successful single-tab recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged extraction and both related recovery changes trace to this contributor’s feature history.
